description: Returns the full Work Insiders profile of one named tool: what it does, pricing with plans and the date the price was checked, free trial, first party MCP server and API, AI features, bottom line, strengths, watch-outs, best for, pros and cons, integrations, Capterra rating and named alternatives. Finding tools by need or filter is what workinsiders_search_tools does.

tool.description: Tool name, slug or Work Insiders URL, for example "Greenhouse" or "greenhouse".

name: workinsiders_get_tool
title: Get one tool in depth
